turns.replyText:
MY ORDER ARRIVED AND ONE ITEM IS DAMAGED, WHAT DO I DO?
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged.
According to Naked Wardrobe’s policy, if your item is defective, damaged, or you received the wrong item, you should INITIATE AN EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL and select the appropriate return reason. You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the issue
- an image of the item
- an image of the care tag located inside the garment
If the request is approved, you’ll receive an email with a PREPAID LABEL.
Their policy also states that ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and THE EXCHANGE CAN ONLY BE FOR THE SAME STYLE.
If you purchased through a third party, the FAQ says to contact that third party first to initiate the return. It also says that for damaged or incorrect garments, you can email INFO@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM with a photo of the item.
If you want, I can also help you find the return portal link.
